ADR-068 — freezes the product's current attributes/documents/subcomponents. An effectiveDate in the future makes it SCHEDULED (auto-promoted to CURRENT when the date arrives); omitted or past makes it CURRENT immediately, archiving whichever version was CURRENT before.
